title: 甘くて小さいヒーロー

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Hishi Akebono mentions that Biko Pegasus doesn't seem her usual self and that her races might be causing her depression.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To help pick up her mood, we invite her out to pick oranges for a change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even during a crisis, Biko Pegasus's courage and infallible spirit shine through. Hishi Akebono looks upon her with glowing admiration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way home, Hishi Akebono offers encouragement to Biko Pegasus, who's been feeling hindered in her races by her small stature.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono tells her how inspired she is by Biko Pegasus's optimism and says she's her hero. Spurred by those words, Biko Pegasus is able to stand tall once again.
